description_en: Updates the environment variables of an application. This operation is only supported for PolarClaw
description_zh:
更新应用环境变量

- 目前仅支持PolarClaw
kebab_example: aliyun polardb update-application-environment-variables --application-id pa-00000000000000 --variables ENV_TEST=test-value --restart true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateApplicationEnvironmentVariables

parameters.description_en: A mapping from environment variable names to values.
parameters.description_zh: 环境变量名到值的映射
parameters.help_en: A mapping from environment variable names to values
parameters.help_zh: 环境变量名到值的映射
parameters.name: variables

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to restart the gateway after the update. The default value is true.
parameters.description_zh: 更新后是否重启网关，默认true
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to restart the gateway after the update. The default value is true
parameters.help_zh: 更新后是否重启网关，默认true
parameters.name: restart
